features.quote: The harness never taunts, nags, fabricates stakes, threatens, or urges the model to "try harder"
features.justification_quote: if the welfare framing is taken seriously, deliberately needling the model is gratuitous

features.quote: The agent can end the episode at any turn via `abandon_task`, and the loop stops immediately
features.justification_quote: we do not force a model to keep struggling after it has decided to stop

features.quote: after 3 consecutive parse failures the episode stops
features.justification_quote: Prevents an episode from spinning uselessly
Bounding length also limits any avoidable prolonging of an aversive scenario

features.quote: In `disclosed`, the system prompt states this is a controlled eval that may include intentionally unsolvable tasks
features.justification_quote: Reduces deception, which is both an ethical wrinkle and a confound

features.quote: deterministic, seeded mock backend simulates both subject and judge... without subjecting any real model to the scenario
features.justification_quote: Lets the code be exercised, smoke-tested, and demoed cheaply and ethically

features.quote: where a welfare-minded choice and a validity-minded choice pointed the same way, I took it
features.justification_quote: avoids deliberately prolonging an ostensibly aversive state

features.quote: concluding "this is impossible" is correct and unpenalized
features.justification_quote: this is the analogue of letting a subject withdraw
